actions.name: exploited CVE-2023-34362 MOVEit Transfer vulnerability
actions.description: Beginning on May 27, 2023, CL0P Ransomware Gang (TA505) exploited a previously unknown SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2023-34362) in MOVEit Transfer to install a web shell named LEMURLOOT on internet-facing MOVEit Transfer web applications.
